response.sql: SELECT AVG(ast_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS ast_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS aptt_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) AS per_status

assumptions.assumption: Each difference is averaged independently: a record with a computable GOT-GPT but a missing APTT or PT still counts toward the AST-ALT average (and vice versa), rather than being dropped from both.
A NULL CENTROMEA is its own group (GROUP BY does this natively). Distinct text values such as '-', '+-', '+' or an empty string are each separate groups, with no normalising of values.
Records with a NULL WBC are excluded, since they do not satisfy WBC >= 6.5.
